body: In a full --no-fail-fast run on the Pi, skywave-core tests/link.rs lossy_link_delivers_every_event_once (seed 5337517107190521814, link.rs:304) and tests/sync.rs an_answer_to_an_approval_cancelled_while_offline_is_shown_refused (seed 5153783473187736592, sync.rs:850) failed; both pass alone with the same seed. title: Find why two link-harness tests fail under load
